acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: main-sync on a diverged branch fails with a distinct, actionable code and performs no git mutation.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Returns merge_wrapper_diverged_requires_explicit_sync naming both explicit verbs. Test asserts the observed call list contains only stash push, the ff-only pull, and stash pop.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: No code path reaches git-rebase-main without the caller naming it.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: The fallback re-invocation is deleted. The refusal test asserts no call containing 'rebase' appears, rather than asserting only on the result code.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: A sync dropping a path under docs/06_status/proof/** or docs/06_status/lanes/** is refused and the tree restored.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: classifyDroppedPaths plus post-sync wiring returns merge_wrapper_sync_dropped_protected_paths; the test asserts git reset --keep <pre-sync-head> was actually invoked.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: A sync that drops any other tracked path reports it.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Non-protected drops append a warning naming each path; the test asserts success is preserved and no restore is attempted.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: A sync that moves the head SHA emits the invalidated-artifact list with re-authorization order.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: buildHeadMoveInvalidation names pm-verdict, t1-approved and EXECUTOR_RESULT; the test asserts verify precedes EXECUTOR_RESULT and pm-verdict is last.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Unit coverage for ff-only success, diverged refusal, explicit merge success, artifact-drop refusal, and invalidation report contents.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: 67 focused tests covering all five cases plus the no-move and unknown-head cases.
No change to lock acquisition or release; the pre-existing lock-held, release-on-failure and dry-run tests pass unmodified in their lock assertions.

known_limitations: The mandatory T1 staging DB proof and the full pnpm verify verdict remain pending until the governed PR CI run completes in the staging-ci environment.

The invalidation report is derived deterministically from the head-SHA change and does not fetch the specific pm-verdict comment URL or label state from GitHub. Fetching would add precision, not correctness; a head move invalidates those artifacts by definition.
MAIN_SYNC_STASH_PATHS covers .ops/sync and docs/06_status/lanes but not docs/06_status/proof/. That gap is out of scope here and is tracked in UTV2-1690.
